name: koa_1
prompt: Generate ONE image, 1536x1024, landscape: a flat, straight-on, evenly lit, high-resolution photograph of a single sheet of real figured Hawaiian koa veneer under clear satin-gloss lacquer, filling the whole frame edge to edge. Honey-brown to dark chocolate koa with natural curly figure (irregular, wavy chatoyant ripples, not regular stripes), darker streaks and real grain variation, grain running horizontally, like a high-end hand-built guitar. No shadows, no reflections, no edges, no objects, no vignetting, no text: just the wood surface, sharp and detailed, so it can be used as a texture.
